title: Desiccant Dryer

introduction.definition: A heatless desiccant dryer dries compressed air by pressure-swing adsorption. One tower dries the air at line pressure while the other is depressurised and swept by a small part of the dried air (purge) that carries away the adsorbed water. The towers switch every few minutes.
applications: Outdoor air lines in freezing climates
key_points: Pressure swing: adsorb high, desorb low
introduction.summary: A heatless desiccant dryer dries compressed air by pressure-swing adsorption. One tower dries the air at line pressure while the other is depressurised and purged with part of the dried air; the towers switch every few minutes.

pressure.title: Pressure swing: adsorb at high pressure, desorb at low
pressure.description: The drying tower works at line pressure (red); the desiccant adsorbs water vapour. The other tower is vented to atmosphere (blue) and swept by a small part of the dry air (purge, typically ~ 15–20 % for heatless dryers) which carries the water out through the silencer. Towers switch every few minutes. Typical pressure dew point −40 °C (−70 °C with molecular sieve).

script.narration: This module introduces the Desiccant Dryer.
A heatless desiccant dryer dries compressed air by pressure-swing adsorption.
One tower dries the air at line pressure while the other is depressurised and swept by a small part of the dried air (purge) that carries away the adsorbed water.
The towers switch every few minutes.
Typical applications include instrument air; pharmaceutical and food air; outdoor air lines in freezing climates.
The cutaway reveals the internal construction.
The exploded view separates every component so each one can be tapped for its function, material and failure modes.

script.narration: How the Desiccant Dryer works.
Wet compressed air passes the pre-filter.
The shuttle valve directs it into the drying tower.
Desiccant adsorbs the water vapour.
Dry air purges the other tower at low pressure.
The controller switches towers.

video_tutorials.title: Desiccant Dryer — Maintenance

script.narration: Maintenance essentials for the Desiccant Dryer.
Check dew point and filter ΔP.
Replace filter elements; check silencers.
Replace desiccant (≈ 3–5 years).
Watch for high dew point: moisture downstream. Common cause: oil-fouled desiccant, low purge, valve fault.
Watch for silencer blockage: slow depressurisation. Common cause: desiccant dust.
Record every inspection so trends — vibration, temperature, leakage and performance — can be compared over time.
